verses.text: My soul waiteth in silence for God only: From him cometh my salvation.

verses.text: He only is my rock and my salvation: He is my high tower; I shall not be greatly moved.

verses.text: How long will ye set upon a man, That ye may slay him, all of you, Like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?

verses.text: They only consult to thrust him down from his dignity; They delight in lies; They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. [Selah

verses.text: My soul, wait thou in silence for God only; For my expectation is from him.

verses.text: With God is my salvation and my glory: The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.

verses.text: Trust in him at all times, ye people; Pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us. [Selah

verses.text: Surely men of low degree are vanity, and men of high degree are a lie: In the balances they will go up; They are together lighter than vanity.

verses.text: Trust not in oppression, And become not vain in robbery: If riches increase, set not your heart thereon.

verses.text: God hath spoken once, Twice have I heard this, That power belongeth unto God.

verses.text: Also unto thee, O Lord, belongeth lovingkindness; For thou renderest to every man according to his work.
